metadata.purpose: Verified 2026 federal and national context; state SUTA/WC remains 2025 in existing Cost Lab pending official verification
metadata.doNotBlend: Do not label the 2025 state reference model as 2026 without updating and reviewing individual state values.
metadata.verification: Each value checked against the cited primary source page on lastReviewed (SSA OACT contribution-and-benefit-base table; KFF EHBS 2026 report page).

annualSinglePremium.label: Avg. annual premium, single coverage (all firms)

annualFamilyPremium.label: Avg. annual premium, family coverage (all firms)

annualSingleEmployerShareDerived.label: Employer share, single (derived: premium − worker contribution)

annualFamilyEmployerShareDerived.label: Employer share, family (derived: premium − worker contribution)

notes: National annual employer cost is premium minus annual worker contribution; do not substitute it for a state-level employer benchmark.
BLS QCEW annual pay is per covered employee and excludes benefits; match ownership and NAICS scope consistently.
